breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim: it states water temperature is 100°C and Hv = 0.3 m. At 100°C, water's vapor pressure head is approximately 10.3 m (essentially atmospheric), not 0.3 m. The agent did not correct either the temperature or the vapor pressure head to make them physically consistent.
